observe.surface: What a Claude Code session with the plugin loaded receives: the replies of the MCP tools in src/server/tools, the output of the hooks registered in hooks/hooks.json (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Stop, SessionEnd), and the thread state document under ~/.logbook and on refs/logbook/threads
observe.value: A named field of a tool reply or a hook's JSON output (additionalContext, decision, reason), the text of a state document section, or the commit a change lands on refs/logbook/threads, never only that a reply or commit exists
observe.observe_by: node:test calling the tool handlers and hook entry points against a disposable store built in a temp directory, and git log or git show on refs/logbook/threads
observe.terminal_action: The accepted write to a state document, which commits to refs/logbook/threads, followed by the background push to origin
observe.build_artifact: The version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, installed into ~/.claude/plugins/cache/logbook/logbook/<version> by a release and a reinstall; a running session keeps the version it loaded at start, so working-tree edits reach no session until then
observe.twin: A state document is written through three paths that each check and commit the change: the MCP tools in src/server/tools, the working-copy Edit path through hooks/pre-tool-use.ts and src/hook, and the command line in src/command/main.ts
observe.dependent: Claude Code sessions with the plugin loaded, the preflight, debrief, file and metrics skills under skills/, and pipeline runs that open, resume and park threads
observe.receipt: A node:test file under test/, run with node --test, red on the base and green on the head; behaviour that shows only in a live session is proved with npm run prove (test/live)
observe.compat_boundary: State documents on refs/logbook/threads and the ~/.logbook working copies, written by one installed version and read by another on a second device not yet updated; and the hook and MCP interfaces of the Claude Code version that loads the plugin

reach.access: Load the worktree into Claude Code with claude --plugin-dir <worktree>; the installed copy in ~/.claude/plugins/cache changes only after a release and reinstall
reach.shortcut: claude --plugin-dir sessions, plus the test suite, which builds its own disposable store in a temp directory; no publish needed
reach.fixtures: A throwaway git repository with an origin remote; the logbook-evals templates are ready-made ones
special_surfaces: hooks firing inside a real Claude Code session (SessionStart, PreToolUse, Stop)
the background push to a real remote
